fieldValues.value: Land carrier and storage changes as one final generation

The Record carrier and repository-authority contracts define one final meaning. Supporting either half as an intermediate public generation would make partial conformance look valid and preserve a bridge with no durable semantic role.

The RFC-039 carrier migration and RFC-038 repository-storage migration land as one composed first-party release train at dataModelRevision 2; neither design ships alone and no intermediate repository generation is supported.
RFC-038/RFC-039 first-party migration and release generation

- Ship the carrier change before the repository-authority change.
- Support an intermediate generation between the two contracts.
- Defer one known first-party population to a later release.
The coupled train is larger, has more prerequisites, and keeps both accepted designs unavailable until the whole ecosystem is ready.
Review if a real external compatibility population requires a staged release, or if the two contracts become independently coherent.
